entry.title: Parks Commission: the meeting of 26 August 2026 — recording, transcript and our minutes
entry.summary: Parks Commission OK'd beach access for a fundraiser and is weighing a $2,200 Wallace Park lighting upgrade. The recording is on the town’s channel (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=myQGZh_udNc), its captions are searchable, and our minutes are written from them; the video at its timestamp is the record.
